GHSA-8cj5-5rvv-wf4v.summary: tar-fs can extract outside the specified dir with a specific tarball
GHSA-8cj5-5rvv-wf4v.description:
### Impact
 v3.0.8, v2.1.2, v1.16.4 and below

### Patches
Has been patched in 3.0.9, 2.1.3, and 1.16.5

### Workarounds
You can use the ignore option to ignore non files/directories.

```js
  ignore (_, header) {
    // pass files & directories, ignore e.g. symlinks
    return header.type !== 'file' && header.type !== 'directory'
  }
```

### Credit
Thank you Caleb Brown from Google Open Source Security Team for reporting this in detail.
